scope: Nested MDB IncludeFiles chain: main K02-derived SXI includes an Access MDB with a sole IncludeFiles row pointing to a second Access MDB with the required BASE-01 Station row.

manual.rule: IncludeFiles supports included data or database files, repeated input tables merge, Control may appear once, and included files may themselves include files. Full paths avoid application-directory dependence.

frozen_commands: create and ODBC-readback level2 Station MDB
create and ODBC-readback level1 IncludeFiles MDB
temporarily map MDB to installed 64-bit Access driver during calculation and restore prior association
acceptance_hypotheses: Level1 has exactly one user IncludeFiles table with one row pointing to the frozen level2 path; level2 has exactly one user Station table with the K02 BASE-01 row.
Main model imports and exports with the sole level1 IncludeFiles row and all other authored K02-derived rows intact, allowing reviewed native empty-default canonicalization.
SIMLOX log explicitly traverses level1 then level2, inserts exactly one Station record, has zero converter errors and only reviewed warnings, and writes a usable SXO and report.
The native event log and raw report are byte-identical to accepted K05/K02 for this fixed teaching model.
gate: Missing or skipped nested include, wrong path or row, duplicate Control, converter error, unusable output, changed event/report, GUI change, registry restore failure or source fingerprint change is NO-GO.
limitations: This tests nested MDB files only. It does not establish nested SXI/OPI modules, relative paths, missing-file behavior, duplicate Control or key-conflict handling, GUI behavior or complete K04 coverage.
